name: Web Review: example.com

launch_readiness.explanation: Moderate Weakness: Primary security controls held, but minor configuration or hygiene improvements are recommended before general availability.

summary: Web security audit (⚡ Quick Sanity Scan) completed for https://example.com. Inspected 1 accessible page(s). Evaluated 10 checks in 1.2s. Observed 4 finding(s), 4 verified defense(s), and 0 unassessed area(s). Safety Score: 50/100 (Grade D). Highest Severity: MEDIUM.

findings.title: Missing `X-Content-Type-Options` header
findings.why_it_matters: Affects user accessibility, browser privacy, or UI resilience.
findings.action: Add `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` header in your hosting configuration to prevent MIME-sniffing attacks.
findings.how_to_verify: Apply recommended configuration fix and re-run audit.

findings.title: Missing `X-Frame-Options` header
findings.why_it_matters: Affects user accessibility, browser privacy, or UI resilience.
findings.action: Add `X-Frame-Options: DENY` or `SAMEORIGIN` to defend against UI clickjacking.
findings.how_to_verify: Apply recommended configuration fix and re-run audit.

findings.title: Missing `Referrer-Policy` header
findings.why_it_matters: Affects user accessibility, browser privacy, or UI resilience.
findings.action: Set `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin` to avoid leaking sensitive URLs in outgoing requests.
findings.how_to_verify: Apply recommended configuration fix and re-run audit.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP)
findings.observed: No `Content-Security-Policy` header found on the root HTML response.
findings.why_it_matters: Affects user accessibility, browser privacy, or UI resilience.
findings.evidence: No `Content-Security-Policy` header found on the root HTML response.
findings.action: Define a CSP header restricting script and object sources: `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self';`.
findings.how_to_verify: Apply recommended configuration fix and re-run audit.
